items.title: Mother told to book appointment to give birth to baby who had died
items.summary: Newcastle Hospitals NHS Trust apologises for care it says "fell short of the standards" expected.

items.title: 'Everything is destroyed': Hackers target refrigerators in new cyber attacks
items.summary: Cyber hackers have targeted fridges and freezers in supermarkets in several European countries including Ireland – causing temperatures to increase and food to spoil.

items.title: Train attacker said 'I am the baddest', trial hears
items.summary: Police responded to fears about Anthony Williams on a train the day before the attack, jurors hear.

items.title: Trans row nurse Sandie Peggie loses discrimination case against union
items.summary: The Royal College of Nursing (RCN) did not discriminate against one of its members because of her gender beliefs, a tribunal has ruled.

items.title: Labour ends power-sharing with Greens in 11 councils over Zionism row
items.summary: Labour's ruling National Executive Committee sets out where it is cutting ties with the Greens.

items.title: FIFA to partially release documents relating to World Cup sell-off plan
items.summary: FIFA will give members of its ruling council access to some documents for the first time related to the World Cup sell-off, Sky News understands.
